newsitem.title: USA: Wausau Paper plans $9.4 mln mill expansion.
newsitem.headline: Wausau Paper plans $9.4 mln mill expansion.

text.p: Wausau Paper Mills Co said Wednesday its board of directors has approved a $9.4 million pulp mill capacity expansion at its printing and writing mill in Brokaw, Wisconsin.
The project is expected to reduce costs and increase pulp production capoacity at the facility by more than 15 percent by improving efficiency and enhancing yields, the paper company said.
The project is expected to be completed by early summer in 1998, Wausau said.
